grammar.title: Asking for and Giving Locations with 'Estar'
grammar.explanation:
To describe where places are located, Spanish uses the verb 'estar' (not 'ser'):

• ¿Dónde está el banco? - Where is the bank?
• El banco está en la calle Mayor. - The bank is on Main Street.

Common location prepositions:
• en - in/on/at
• cerca de - near
• lejos de - far from
• al lado de - next to
• enfrente de - in front of / across from
• detrás de - behind
• entre - between

examples.target: El museo está al lado del hotel.
examples.native: The museum is next to the hotel.

examples.target: La estación está enfrente de la iglesia.
examples.native: The station is across from the church.
